idea-plugin.name: Mission Passed
idea-plugin.description:
Your IDE, GTA style. A fan homage to Grand Theft Auto VI (GTA 6): green tests are a MISSION PASSED!, red ones get you WASTED, and every warning in your file raises your wanted level. A bit of gamification for your test runs.

Features

  • MISSION PASSED! fades in over the IDE when a test run passes (with RESPECT + one per test) or a run configuration exits with code 0.
  • WASTED: the IDE turns grey with a big red banner when tests fail or a run ends with an error exit code. Runs you stop yourself don't count.
  • Busy elsewhere? If the IDE is in the background, the banner waits until you switch back.
  • Wanted level: up to five stars in the status bar. Warnings in the current file count one point, errors two. Clean code, zero stars.
  • Doesn't block anything: the banners ignore the mouse and disappear after a few seconds.

Usage

  • Just run your tests. Preview the banners via Tools | Mission Passed.
  • Settings: Settings | Tools | Mission Passed.

Mission Passed is an unofficial fan project. It is not affiliated with, endorsed or sponsored by Rockstar Games or Take-Two Interactive. Grand Theft Auto is a trademark of Take-Two Interactive Software, Inc.
